story.iWant: split a clip at the playhead position
story.soThat: I can separate sections and remove unwanted parts
story.tasks: - Add splitClip action to timelineStore (calculate split position, create two new clips with UUIDs, preserve trim values) - Create SplitTool component with Split button UI - Implement split handler logic (validate playhead on clip, call splitClip action) - Update Timeline component to display split clips - Handle edge cases and validation (prevent split at start/end, handle trimmed clips) - Test split functionality end-to-end

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: AC1: "Split" button available in timeline toolbar AC2: User positions playhead on a clip and clicks Split AC3: Selected clip splits into two separate clips at playhead position AC4: Both resulting clips appear on timeline with correct durations AC5: Split clips can be individually selected, moved, or deleted AC6: Split operation is immediate (no loading delay)

docs.doc: Split operation divides clip at playhead. Creates two new clips with unique UUIDs. Clip A: original start → playhead. Clip B: playhead → original end. Original clip removed. Must complete synchronously (<16ms per NFR001).
User positions playhead on clip → clicks Split button → splitClip(clipId, playheadPosition) called → Store creates two clips at same timeline position → Timeline re-renders with both clips visible.

EditTools folder at src/renderer/components/EditTools/ for Epic 3 editing components. SplitTool.tsx is new component. State mutations in src/renderer/store/timelineStore.ts with Zustand immutability patterns.
Application shall support split operation at playhead position to divide clips. NFR001: Timeline UI shall maintain 30+ fps responsiveness with 10 or more clips loaded.

constraints.constraint: Zustand immutability: splitClip creates new clips array, never mutates existing clips
NFR001: Split operation must complete within 16ms (synchronous, UI remains 60fps)
Use crypto.randomUUID() for new clip IDs (native browser API)
Renderer-only operation: No IPC calls, pure state mutation in renderer process
Split position must be within clip bounds (not at start or end, respect trim boundaries)

interface.name: splitClip

tests.standards: Use Vitest testing framework. Unit tests for splitClip action in timelineStore.test.ts. Test state immutability (original state not mutated). Test UUID generation for new clips. Use describe/it/expect pattern.

ideas.idea: Manual test: Verify Split button appears in timeline toolbar
Test splitClip action: pass clip at position 5s, split at 3s → creates two clips (0-3s, 3-5s)
Test splitClip generates unique UUIDs for both new clips (not same ID as original)
Test split clips have correct durations: Clip A duration = splitPoint, Clip B duration = original duration - splitPoint
Test split clips have correct startTimes: Clip A startTime = original, Clip B startTime = original + splitPoint
Manual test: After split, select each clip individually, verify selection works
Manual test: After split, delete one clip, verify other remains
Performance test: Measure splitClip execution time, verify <16ms
Test split at clip start (position === clip.startTime) → should error/prevent
Test split at clip end (position === clip.endTime) → should error/prevent
Test split on trimmed clip → verify trim values preserved correctly in both clips
